_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.2 (the real file is narrative-seed's). The key order of `teaches` IS the teaching order (arc-shapes section 5).

expedition-dispatch.description: How to send, wait for and collect an expedition.
expedition-dispatch.teachingLine: Send a squad out while you work the lawn; it comes back with what it finds.

talk-verbs.negative: Not a promise that talking wins.
talk-verbs.teachingLine: You can argue with people, or lean on them; both are a roll, not a guarantee.

offer-cost.description: That an offer spends a stock the runtime prices.
offer-cost.teachingLine: An offer spends what you actually hold.

bring-option.description: That the right companion opens a choice.
bring-option.teachingLine: Some doors only open for the right company.

relation-bands.description: That choices move a character along the one ladder.
relation-bands.teachingLine: People remember what you did to them.

quest-log.description: Where offered quests are kept and how to drop one for free.
quest-log.teachingLine: Offered work waits in your log, and leaving it costs nothing.

delve-extract.description: That extracting banks the haul and a wipe loses it.
delve-extract.teachingLine: Carry the haul out and it is yours; fall down here and it is not.

world-command.description: That End Turn commits every order at once.
world-command.teachingLine: Give your orders, then end the turn: everything moves at once.

fusion.description: That duplicates and essence fuse into stronger forms.
fusion.teachingLine: Two of the same creature, and what you feed them, make something stronger.

counter-doctrine.description: That the antagonist adapts to how you fight, and a raid sets it back.
counter-doctrine.loop: 3. Farming, hunting, and defending the empire
counter-doctrine.teachingLine: It learns your habits; hit the study and it forgets some.
